class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="mcp-services">MCP<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">MCP（Model Context Protocol）可以把文件系统、浏览器、记忆、数据库等外部能力接入 Agent。ZCode 会统一管理 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">ZCode Agent</strong> 使用的 MCP 服务器配置。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">给 ZCode Agent 配好常用 MCP 后，Agent 在长任务里可以更稳定地使用项目文件、浏览器自动化、记忆等工具，配合 GLM 5.3 系列模型时也更适合处理连续、多步骤的开发任务。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-mcp-server-list.webp" alt="ZCode Agent MCP 服务器列表" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="scopes">列表分组<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">MCP 列表按来源分为两组：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">已配置 MCP 服务器</strong>：你手动添加的 MCP 服务，可直接编辑、删除或启用/停用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Plugin MCP 服务器</strong>：随插件一起安装的 MCP 服务，由对应插件统一管理。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">列表中每个 MCP 都会展示名称、来源、启动方式和命令。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-mcp-server-list-groups.webp" alt="MCP 列表按来源分组：已配置服务可直接管理，Plugin 服务随插件托管" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="create-mcp">新建 MCP 服务器<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 -&gt; MCP 服务器</strong>，点击右上角 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建 MCP 服务器</strong>。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">表单</strong> 模式适合快速填写常见 stdio 服务：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">作用域</strong>：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户</strong>（所有工作区可用）或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区</strong>（仅当前项目可用）。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">填写名称，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">memory</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">类型选择 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">stdio（本地命令）</code>，也支持 SSE 和 HTTP 类型的远程服务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">填写命令，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">npx</code>，以及参数，例如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">-y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory</code>。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">如服务需要密钥或路径，再展开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">环境变量（可选）</strong> 填写。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">添加</strong> 后回到列表，并确认开关处于启用状态。</li>
</ol>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-mcp-server-create-form.webp" alt="新建 MCP 服务器" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">除 stdio 本地命令外，还有两种录入方式：接入远程服务时，类型选择 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">HTTP</code> 或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">SSE</code>，填写服务地址即可，需要鉴权的服务可展开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">请求头（可选）</strong> 补充 Authorization 等信息；如果已有现成 JSON 配置，则切换到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">完整配置</strong> 模式直接粘贴，支持 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{&quot;server-name&quot;: {...}}</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{&quot;mcpServers&quot;: {...}}</code> 两种常见结构。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260612-mcp-create-modes-duo.webp" alt="左：HTTP 远程服务表单；右：完整配置模式直接粘贴 JSON" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="oauth">需要 OAuth 授权的服务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有些远程 MCP 服务（例如 Figma 的官方 MCP）不接受固定密钥，而是要求你在浏览器里授权一次。为这类服务开启 OAuth 后，剩下的交给 ZCode。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">授权需要你点一下：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → MCP</strong> 里对应的服务行会出现 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">打开授权</strong> 按钮，点击后用系统浏览器打开授权页面，你确认完，ZCode 会自动重连并加载它的工具。ZCode 不会擅自弹出浏览器窗口，主动权在你。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">插件自带的 MCP 服务同样支持，列表行会显示「需要授权」。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">两点需要知道：这只适用于 HTTP 和 SSE 类型的远程服务，本地服务仍然通过环境变量传凭据；如果新建会话时授权一直没完成，ZCode 只会把这一个服务标记为失败，不会拖住整个会话。之后如果换了服务地址或授权范围，需要重新授权一次。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="import-from-external-agent">从外部 Agent 导入 MCP 服务器<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果你已经在 Claude Code、Codex CLI、OpenCode 等外部 Agent 中配置了一批 MCP 服务器，不需要在 ZCode 里逐个重建。在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 服务器</strong> 页面右上角点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导入</strong> 图标，ZCode 会自动扫描这些外部 Agent 的配置文件，把已有的 MCP 服务器集中列出，供你一次性导入。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-mcp-import-external.webp" alt="从外部 Agent 导入 MCP 服务器" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 会从以下来源发现可导入的 MCP 服务器：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Claude Code</strong>：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.claude/settings.json</code></li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Codex CLI</strong>：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.codex/config.toml</code></li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">OpenCode</strong>：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.config/opencode/opencode.json</code></li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">通用 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code></strong>：<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.agents/mcp.json</code></li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">操作步骤：</p>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在 ZCode 设置中进入 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">MCP 服务器</strong> 页面。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击右上角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导入</strong> 图标，打开「导入外部 Agent MCP 服务器」弹窗。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">在弹窗右上角选择导入的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">作用域</strong>（全局或当前工作区）。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">勾选要导入的服务器，或点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全选</strong>；弹窗会实时显示发现的可导入数量与已选数量。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">导入</strong> 完成导入，服务器会出现在列表中并默认启用。</li>
</ol>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">导入后的服务器会和手动添加的服务一样保存在对应作用域的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 配置文件中，可以在 ZCode 内继续编辑、启停或删除，原外部 Agent 的配置文件不会被修改。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="config-files">配置文件与默认读取路径<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">设置面板只是入口之一。ZCode 按固定的目录约定读取 MCP 配置文件，你也可以直接手工编辑这些文件来批量管理服务：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">作用域</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">文件路径</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/cli/config.json</code></td><td class="border-t border-border class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">用户 · <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 兼容</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.agents/mcp.json</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcpServers</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">工作区 · <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 兼容</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;项目根&gt;/.agents/mcp.json</code></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mcpServers</code></td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">注意：用户级原生配置在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode/cli/</code> 目录下，而工作区级直接在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode/</code> 目录下，两个文件同名为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">config.json</code> 但层级不同。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 原生配置（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">config.json</code>）的 MCP 部分形如：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-json">{
  &quot;mcp&quot;: {
    &quot;servers&quot;: {
      &quot;memory&quot;: {
        &quot;command&quot;: &quot;npx&quot;,
        &quot;args&quot;: [&quot;-y&quot;, &quot;@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory&quot;],
        &quot;env&quot;: {}
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents/mcp.json</code> 则使用业界通用的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">{&quot;mcpServers&quot;: {...}}</code> 结构，便于和其他支持 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 目录约定的 AI 工具共享同一份 MCP 配置。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="load-order">读取规则与优先级<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<ol class="mb-4 list-decimal list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区优先加载</strong>：打开工作区时先读取工作区作用域的配置，再读取用户作用域，两边的服务都会出现在列表中。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同作用域内 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 强优先</strong>：只要 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 配置文件里读到了任何 MCP 服务，同作用域的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents/mcp.json</code> 就会被整体跳过，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不做合并</strong>。<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 只在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 没有配置任何服务时才作为兜底来源生效。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">启用状态记录在配置对象内</strong>：在列表里停用某个 MCP 时，ZCode 会向该服务的配置对象写入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&quot;enable&quot;: false</code>；没有这个字段即视为启用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">面板写入永远落在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code></strong>：通过设置面板新增或编辑的服务，始终写回对应作用域的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 原生配置文件，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 文件不会被修改。</li>
</ol>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">提示</strong>：如果你在 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents/mcp.json</code> 里维护了一批服务，又在设置面板里新建了一个服务，原来 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 里的服务会因为 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 优先规则而整体失效。此时把 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.agents</code> 里的配置合并进 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode</code> 配置文件即可。</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="workspace-trust">工作区 MCP 会自动连接<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">写在项目配置里的 MCP 服务，在会话启动时会和用户级服务一样 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动连接</strong>，不需要你每次手动授权。这让团队把 MCP 配置提交进仓库后，成员克隆下来就能直接用。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">方便之外有件事需要留意。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">打开一个项目，就等于连上了它配置里写的所有 MCP 服务</strong>，而 MCP 服务能执行命令、读写你的文件、访问网络。所以打开来路不明的仓库之前，建议先看一眼它的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.zcode/config.json</code>，确认里面的 MCP 配置你都认得。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">同名服务以你自己的配置为准，项目配置覆盖不了它。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="recommended">推荐配置<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">下面这些推荐优先使用智谱相关 MCP，点击卡片可直达智谱官方文档查看完整说明与配置方法：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/mcp/vision-mcp-server"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">zai-mcp-server</code></a>：提供视觉理解能力，让 Agent 可以分析图片、截图和界面信息。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/mcp/search-mcp-server"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">web-search-prime</code></a>：提供联网搜索能力，让 Agent 获取最新资料和外部信息。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/mcp/reader-mcp-server"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">web-reader</code></a>：提供网页读取能力，让 Agent 解析网页正文、结构和关键信息。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这些服务通常需要配置智谱 API Token。团队内如果有统一 MCP 规范，建议用 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用户</strong> 作用域共享通用服务，再按项目需要在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区</strong> 作用域补充专用服务，避免配置互相污染。</p>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
